name: net.veloxity.sdk.BootReceiver
description: Veloxity registers this Receiver for device boot, quick-boot, and its own startup signal. Version 6.1.9 initializes the SDK on boot; version 7.0.3 proceeds only for Veloxity’s startup signal.
disableEffect: Veloxity may not restore its contextual tracking and offer service after startup; the host app’s ordinary screens remain available.
